papers.title: Computation-through-Dynamics Toolkit: Simulated datasets and quality metrics for dynamical models of neural activity.
papers.reason: Filtered because it uses synthetic neural-dynamics datasets and toolkit metrics rather than human or animal cognition and is not explicitly modelling executive function.

papers.title: Decomposing Models of Bounded Rationality
papers.reason: The paper directly compares formal bounded-rationality models against human strategic decision-making data, making it relevant to computational modelling of human decision processes.

papers.title: Domain-dependent mechanisms of L2 proficiency in interference suppression: A drift-diffusion analysis of verbal and spatial Stroop in Chinese–English bilinguals
papers.reason: The paper uses hierarchical Bayesian drift-diffusion modelling to decompose human Stroop interference suppression and cognitive control across verbal and spatial domains.

papers.title: A Cognitive-Adaptive Sight-Singing and Ear-Training Integration Model
papers.reason: The paper proposes a cognitive educational framework involving working memory limits and predictive coding, but its main focus is music pedagogy rather than quantitative executive-function modelling.

papers.title: Genetic basis of phase amplitude coupling entrained by working memory
papers.reason: The title indicates a neuroscience study of phase-amplitude coupling linked to working memory, which could inform mechanistic models of working-memory neural dynamics.

papers.title: Task-evoked brain network dynamics underlying executive function in preadolescent children.
papers.reason: The paper reports EEG-based dynamic functional-connectivity findings during a flanker task and links network states to selective attention and inhibitory control in children.

papers.title: Toward AI-Enabled Precision Exercise: Neurophysiological Effects of Acute Moderate-Intensity Resistance Exercise on Executive Function in College Students with Different Motor Skill Backgrounds
papers.reason: The paper measures Stroop, n-back, shifting performance and prefrontal fNIRS responses, but its central emphasis is an exercise intervention rather than modelling executive function.

papers.title: Operant House: A versatile open-source platform for automated operant conditioning testing of mice in home cages
papers.reason: The paper introduces an animal behavioural platform for working-memory and flexibility testing and demonstrates early working-memory deficits in an Alzheimer’s mouse model.

papers.title: Video EEG in pediatric epilepsy: Diagnostic significance and association between frequency band power and cognitive impairment severity.
papers.reason: The paper appears to relate EEG frequency-band power to clinical cognitive impairment severity, but there is no clear executive-function task or modelling component in the available text.

papers.title: Novel Genetic Variants of the CHD2 Gene in cis Position in a Patient with Epileptic Encephalopathy: A Case Report and In Silico Analysis of the Impact of the Variants on the Protein
papers.reason: The paper is primarily a clinical genetics case report for epileptic encephalopathy, with cognitive impairment mentioned only as a clinical feature rather than an executive-function focus.

papers.title: Visual Search Behavior Towards Reference Areas During an S-Curve Driving Task in Elderly Drivers with Mild Cognitive Impairment
papers.reason: The paper uses eye tracking during a naturalistic driving task to characterize visual-search behaviour in elderly drivers with MCI features, making it relevant to digital behavioural biomarkers.

papers.title: Computational approaches to deep learning–driven EEG analysis for neurological disease diagnosis: a systematic review
papers.reason: The review covers deep-learning EEG biomarkers for neurological diagnosis including MCI and Alzheimer’s disease, though it is broad and not specifically focused on executive-function assessment.

papers.title: Examining sources of variability in repeated testing of the rewards positivity and P300 ERP components
papers.reason: The paper provides human EEG reliability data for P300 and reward positivity in repeated cognitive tasks, but its main contribution is ERP measurement methodology rather than executive-function mechanisms.

papers.title: Multimodal Sensing and Digital Biomarkers in Virtual Reality-Based Cognitive Rehabilitation: Clinical Validation, Adaptive Systems, and Real-World Translation
papers.reason: The review is closely aligned with multimodal digital biomarkers for cognitive rehabilitation, including behavioural, eye-tracking, physiological, EEG and fNIRS measures for MCI and functional outcomes.
